summary: Skewed healthcheck tick causing API-Gateway 5xx spike and runtime thread panic
description:
Issue summary: Between 2026-03-10 03:22 UTC and 2026-03-10 04:05 UTC we observed a sharp elevation in 5xx responses for customer routes served from us-east-1. Impact: multiple ByteCart endpoints returned 502/503 across short-lived windows, causing degraded UX and several retries. Environment: prod (dedicated pool for ByteCart). Observed behavior: API-Gateway returned a mix of 502/503 with rapid spikes aligned to backend healthcheck flaps. Runtimes backing the tenant reported thread panics and abrupt restarts during the same window. The issue recurred in a ~40s on / 80s off pattern.

Immediate business impact: customer observed failed payments and chat prompt failures for ~10 minutes total across the hour window.

Primary ask: triage root cause, restore steady healthy routing, provide immediate mitigation for ByteCart, and recommend long-term guardrails to prevent recurrence.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Replay tenant traffic using dedicated pool traffic generator (scale to 150 concurrent streams).
2) Inject a 60s skewed healthcheck delay on 20% of ephemerals (simulate 2s late heartbeat).
3) Observe API-Gateway health mark removal and connection handoffs to warmup workers.
4) Monitor runtime logs for thread watchdog triggers and GPU prefetch messages.
observed_logs: 2026-03-10T03:24:02Z apigw us-east proxy: upstream status 502 - 'no healthy upstreams'
2026-03-10T03:24:05Z runtime node-27: ERROR ThreadWatchdog: worker_main thread panicked: assertion 'kv_cache_state != LOCKED' failed
2026-03-10T03:24:06Z runtime node-27: WARN gpu_prefetch: canceling prefetch because worker eviction in progress
2026-03-10T03:24:07Z autoscaler: INFO evicting ephemeral worker node-27 due to failed healthcheck (latency 2.1s)
timeline: 03:21 UTC - small uptick in tenant traffic (normal).
03:22 UTC - first apigw 502 seen on ByteCart route.
03:23 UTC - runtime node-27 logs thread watchdog panic and restart.
03:24 UTC - autoscaler evicts several ephemerals after healthchecks time out.
03:26 UTC - traffic shifts to warmed workers; short-term latency increases and a second wave of 5xx as prefetched KV caches collide.
04:05 UTC - pattern subsides after scale stabilization; metrics return to baseline.
investigation_notes: Hypothesis 1: Healthcheck timer skew on a subset of ephemerals caused them to be marked unhealthy in bursts, triggering rapid reconnects and routing churn at API-Gateway.

Hypothesis 2: Eviction of ephemerals during active prefetch/writeback created KV-cache lock contention leading to 'kv_cache_state != LOCKED' assertions and thread watchdog panics in the serving runtime.
Metric checks: apigw 5xx rate correlated with ephemeral healthcheck-fail events (cross-correlation r=0.78).
Heap/CPU: affected runtime nodes showed CPU spike (user 85->98%) and transient increase in pagefaults during panic windows.
Network: no packet loss observed; TLS handshakes normal.
Observed that prefetch cancelation logs appear exactly at eviction timestamp; stack traces point at kv_cache::writeback path.
diagnostics_performed: Checked apigw health events and routing logs for ByteCart route (apigw-cluster-23).
Pulled runtime thread dumps from node-27 and node-31 during the window.
Replayed tenant traffic in staging with skewed healthcheck to reproduce the pattern (reproduced).
Run grep on logs for 'kv_cache' and 'ThreadWatchdog' across candidate nodes (nodes 24-32).
Examined autoscaler events: rapid 3->7 eviction/fork cycles in 90s window.
root_cause: A combination of a subtle healthcheck timer drift in the ephemeral worker supervisor and aggressive eviction policy caused grouped worker terminations while those workers were performing GPU prefetch/writeback. The termination during critical KV cache operations led to cache lock assertions and runtime thread panics, which propagated upstream as 502/503 from API-Gateway during repeated routing handoffs.
temporary_workaround: 1) Increased healthcheck grace period for ByteCart dedicated pool from 1s to 3s to reduce false/uncoordinated evictions. 2) Adjusted autoscaler cooldown to 60s for the affected pool to avoid oscillatory evictions. 3) Applied routing sticky window of 15s to reduce immediate handoffs during transient flaps.
resolution_notes: Mitigation actions applied 2026-03-10 05:00 UTC reduced 5xx spikes to baseline within ~10 minutes. Follow-up fix implemented in runtime PR (https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/11234) to make kv_cache writeback safe against concurrent termination and drop the assertion. Autoscaler config change merged into prod config repo. All changes rolled out to us-east-1 dedicated pools by 2026-03-11.
postmortem_actions: ENG: backport kv_cache hardening to release-1.3 branch and roll to dedicated pools (PR #11234 merged).
SRE: add metric 'ephemeral_healthcheck_skew' alert when >5% of pool shows >1s variance in health tick within 5m window.
SRE: create a playbook entry for 'healthcheck-oscillation' and add runbook steps for cooling autoscaler and enabling sticky routing during recovery.
DX: notify ByteCart CS contact with RCA and timeline; offer a dedicated monitoring dashboard for their pool.
comments: 2026-03-10 03:35 - Support (Aisha): Customer ByteCart reports intermittent 502/503 for payments. Collecting logs and escalated to SRE.
2026-03-10 03:48 - SRE (Marcus): Observed thread watchdog panics on node-27; suspect eviction while writeback in progress. Reproduced in staging with delayed health ticks.
2026-03-10 04:12 - Support (Aisha): Applied temporary healthcheck grace for ByteCart pool; asking customer to validate.
2026-03-10 04:26 - Customer (ByteCart-SRE): Confirmed errors reduced but still see occasional timeouts during high bursts.
2026-03-11 09:10 - Eng (Priya Nair): Merged kv_cache safety fix and scheduled rollout to us-east-1 dedicated pools.
2026-03-12 14:00 - CS (Aisha): Shared RCA doc with ByteCart and arranged follow-up call to review guardrails.
follow_up_items: Schedule a postmortem meeting with ByteCart and SRE/ENG within 7 days.
Instrument 'prefetch_in_progress' gauge for runtime to correlate eviction times with prefetch activity.
Tune autoscaler policies to prefer graceful drain over immediate eviction when prefetch or writeback flags present.
Add e2e test in CI that simulates healthcheck skew and verifies no kv_cache assertion/failure.
